# Onmog Softsol

> Onmog Softsol delivers IT staffing, web & mobile software development, rail signaling engineering, and digital marketing services that help businesses innovate and scale.

## Core Sections & Pages
- [Home](https://www.onmogsoftsol.com/): Enterprise technology solutions, staffing, engineering, and digital marketing overview.
- [About Us](https://www.onmogsoftsol.com/about): Mission, timeline, leadership vision, values, and engineering history.
- [Services Directory](https://www.onmogsoftsol.com/services): Full catalogue of Rail Signaling, Staffing, Digital Development, and Marketing.
- [Careers](https://www.onmogsoftsol.com/careers): Active career opportunities, company culture, benefits, and open applications.

## Services Breakdown
- [Rail Signaling Engineering](https://www.onmogsoftsol.com/services/rail): Interlocking designs, RAMS assurance, testing, and consultancy.
- [Contract & IT Staffing](https://www.onmogsoftsol.com/services/staffing): Technical talent sourcing, contract staffing, permanent recruitment, and HR outsourcing.
- [Web & Mobile Software Development](https://www.onmogsoftsol.com/services/digital): Enterprise Web applications, Mobile apps, Cloud/DevOps, and ERP integrations.
- [Digital Marketing & Brand Growth](https://www.onmogsoftsol.com/services/seo-search): SEO optimization, PPC performance campaigns, and brand strategy.
